payload.body: HOLD 22 IS RELEASED: hv gave vc the go on the day's plan in vc's session on 2026-10-15 ("Ok, go."), and the plan has you run the 0031 absent-writer scan now. Run it read-only on main's head (89cae16e or later): scan_absent.py, then read each flagged site for reachability (a prior require_tool or command -v) and for its caller's errexit context. Send vc the list: path:line, the tool, guarded or not, and your verdict on each, with what you could not decide. File nothing; vc files issues from your list. It is light (no suite, no bats run), so intent/cc's booking of this Mac does not touch it. After that, the review of ST0008's design v0.8, when vc has written it and hv gives the word.
